## F38 closed

F38 childless-rhyolite-puma is closed with a certified completion-verifier PASS bound to merged revision 781733f6d82e734c64e6b1550cd523e3a5637ee4. Standalone verification attempts encountered agrologic-oval-bobolink during attested fetch. The normal transition close used the documented fetch-free fixed-ref path and succeeded without force. The close command reported pending tracker publication while the shared write lock was busy. A subsequent tracker read confirmed the closed state and signed completion record.
